items.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023
items.q: I work with Gregory Howe of Wide Hive Records, a man that was wide open to new ideas

ctx.x: Well yeah and I took that even further I mean you know ‘cause I’m a composer as well. So I have several pieces and CDs and so on that I’ve put out with the orchestra that I founded when I was teaching at Mills College you know. So yeah, let’s see hold it, I’ve lost my thought for a minute — I’ve got out several CDs of this — and one of my CDs

won the New York Times Award of the Year. And the thing about it is that what I did was went out to Mills College and put together my own 36-piece chamber orchestra and then recorded them all. I work with Gregory Howe of Wide Hive Records, a man that was wide open to new ideas and so on and so forth. My CDs “Conversations” numbers 1 and 2 with Craig Taborn and Kikanju Baku I transcribed our improvisations and turned those into like pieces for orchestra. And that gave me a chance to work on improvisation in…

Yes I remember reading that quote from you and I thought it was very interesting, and then you had also said, “If you’re sitting at home composing you’ve got time but what you want to get yourself to the point to where you can make these decisions spontaneously.” In the context you were talking about the super musician.
